ideas.pitch: An AI platform that analyzes early-stage startup pitch decks and financial models, generating a comprehensive VC investment readiness score and risk assessment report.
ideas.title: VentureScout: AI Startup Due Diligence & Pitch Deck Scoring Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeted directly at the VCs and founders judging the VentureX grand finale by solving their exact evaluation bottleneck using explainable AI analytics.

ideas.pitch: A streamlined equity simulation and term sheet parser that helps Indian student and early-stage founders model dilution, vesting schedules, and liquidation preferences.
ideas.title: CapTableX: Automated Term Sheet & Cap Table Simulation Tool for Founders
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides high utility for the student founders and entrepreneurs attending E-Summit who desperately need transparent legal and financial modeling tools.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent matching platform designed for hackathons and incubation cells that pairs technical builders with domain-expert co-founders based on past projects and skill gaps.
ideas.title: FounderMatch: AI Co-Founder Networking & Skills Complementarity Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the primary networking goal of the Entrepreneurship & Incubation Cell by creating tangible team-forming infrastructure during the event.

ideas.pitch: A smart aggregation and application assistant for Indian government grants, incubator seed funds, and non-dilutive startup funding opportunities.
ideas.title: GrantRadar: Automated Startup Grant & Non-Dilutive Funding Discovery Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals directly to the incubation cell and early-stage startup ecosystem by addressing the immediate need for non-dilutive capital discovery.

ideas.pitch: A webcam-based speech and objection analysis tool that simulates aggressive VC questioning and evaluates founder pitch delivery metrics in real time.
ideas.title: PitchPrep: Real-Time AI Pitch Deck Delivery & Objection Handling Simulator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly prepares finalists for pitching in front of Venture Capitalists by practicing hard Q&A scenarios under pressure.
